name: test-badge
description: After Claude changes your code, runs the project's tests and its style-rule check (lint) on their own and shows the result in one line (tests 41/42 · style rules: 2 errors · 4s ago), with a panel that lists each failing test and where it is. It also follows the automatic checks GitHub runs on your open change request (pull request), through the gh tool.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: The command that runs your tests, if the one found on its own is wrong (it runs in the project's main folder); leave empty to find it automatically

lintCommand.title: Style-rule check command
lintCommand.description: The command that checks the code against its style rules (lint), if the one found on its own is wrong; leave empty to find it automatically

openCommand.title: Open command
openCommand.description: How a failing test opens its file in your editor, e.g. "cursor -g {file}:{line}"; leave empty to use VS Code, or else the computer's default app
